facts.fact: 逃离 Avernon：兄弟说服她骑上“怪物”夜行数小时
facts.anchor: They had fled the town immediately after retrieving her things, and somehow the brothers convinced her

facts.fact: 生物/怪物之分：生物天生可选择非天生恶；怪物由恶意造
facts.anchor: They’re born like the rest of us, with the ability to learn and choose a life they want. They’re not inherently evil.

facts.fact: 兽种 kitzek：极亲人，忠诚仅次于对彼此
facts.anchor: The kitzek are exceptionally affectionate,” he continued, rubbing a hand down the dark fur

facts.fact: 手语拼名：Q-U-E-N-T-I-N=哑巴哥哥；蓝眼弟弟 Rayner
facts.anchor: We’re pleased to meet you, Andra. I’m Rayner.

facts.fact: 自缝腹伤喝最后一瓶金色镇痛药水——库存见底
facts.anchor: Assessing her stock, she realized that was the last of the glorious pain-relieving tonic she had brought with her

facts.fact: 身世：十岁父母病亡买不起药；数月后村庄遭袭 Quentin 被割舌
facts.anchor: Mom and dad both got sick when we were ten, and we didn’t have money for healing tonics.

facts.fact: Rayner 抱着流血的双胞胎弟弟——全村无一人幸免
facts.anchor: I held my twin brother in my arms outside our cottage as he bled out. It was agony for both of us.

facts.fact: 神秘光系女人：止血+恢复体力后消失——来历不明
facts.anchor: She stopped the bleeding and restored his strength. And then she was gone.

facts.fact: 南林十六年没见过境内怪物——数周前她的村庄遭袭
facts.anchor: The Southern Woods hasn’t seen a monster inside its territory in sixteen years.

facts.fact: 怪物之“洞”传闻——兄弟打算北上查证
facts.anchor: This is going to sound batshit crazy, but there’s been talk of some sort of hole that the monsters are coming from.

facts.fact: 她交底全部：继承人身份+Vasara 索债+冬至月升期限
facts.anchor: If I don’t show up in the Northeastern Shores by moonrise on winter solstice, Vasara will kill someone from my village

facts.fact: 章末定音：“是的——我们一起找到它并封上”
facts.anchor: Yes,” Rayner repeated. “We’ll find the hole and we’ll close it. Together.”
